# Data Guide

## The short version

**Every dataset in this book and repository is synthetic and generated by code you can read.**

- No real-world dataset is used.
- No third-party dataset is redistributed.
- No dataset contains personal, private or sensitive information.
- Nothing is downloaded; no account or API key is needed anywhere.
- Nothing can rot behind a dead link.

Full provenance for each file is in **`DATA_MANIFEST.csv`**.

---

## The datasets

| File | Generated by | Used in |

| `retail.csv` | `code/ch17/gen_retail.py` | Ch 4, 17 |
| `transactions.csv` | `code/ch22/gen_tx.py` | Ch 22, 23 |
| `customers.csv` | `code/ch24/gen_orders.py` | Ch 21, 24, 25 |
| `segments.csv` | `code/ch26/gen_seg.py` | Ch 26, 27 |
| `daily_revenue.csv` | generated inline in Chapter 28 | Ch 28 |

Regenerate all of them:

```bash
python scripts/regenerate_data.py
```

Generators are seeded, so regeneration is byte-identical.

---

## Synthetic does not mean arbitrary

Each dataset is constructed so a specific lesson is visible and measurable — a genuine group
base-rate difference in Chapter 44, a repeated-entity structure in Chapter 16, a concept drift in
Chapter 43. The book states the construction openly in each case, because a demonstration you cannot
inspect teaches nothing.

**Where a construction favours the conclusion, the book says so.** Chapter 35 notes that its example
"guarantees transfer looks good"; Chapter 39 notes its task "was built as a linear perturbation…
exactly what LoRA parameterizes". That honesty is deliberate and should be preserved in any
derivative use of this material.

---

## Simulations versus datasets

Chapters 37, 40 and 41 do not use a dataset at all. They run **disclosed deterministic simulations**
— a toy reward model, a toy judge, a simulated tool-calling agent — and each states this in the
first line of its worked example, e.g.:

> *"No real model or API is used anywhere in this chapter; every number below comes from a disclosed,
> deterministic simulation."*

Do not present numbers from those chapters as measurements of any real system.

---

## External data

**There is none.** If you extend this repository with external data, record it in
`DATA_MANIFEST.csv` with its licence and redistribution status, and do not commit restricted data —
add an acquisition script instead.
